# React Flow Architecture & API

Reference file for Dimension 1. All citations reference [citations.md](../citations.md).

## Package & Versioning

React Flow was renamed from `reactflow` to `@xyflow/react` in v12 [6]. The framework-agnostic
core lives in `@xyflow/system` with vanilla TypeScript algorithms; the React layer uses
Zustand internally for state management [3]. Latest release is v12.x (v2.0.0 of dagre
released November 2025 [25]; no v13 of React Flow exists yet).

The library is MIT-licensed and free for commercial use. React Flow Pro is an optional
subscription for pro examples and direct support — no features are paywalled [46].

## Core Data Model

| Concept | Structure | Key Properties |
|---------|-----------|----------------|
| Node | Object | `id`, `position`, `data`, `type`, `measured` (v12+) [6] |
| Edge | Object | `id`, `source`, `target`, `type`, `sourceHandle`, `targetHandle` [21] |
| Handle | Component | `type` (source/target), `position`, `id` (for multiple handles) [1] |
| Viewport | Object | `x`, `y`, `zoom` [26] |

Four built-in edge types: bezier/default, straight, step, smoothstep [21].

## Custom Nodes

Custom nodes are React components wrapped by React Flow in an interactive container [1].
Registration pattern:

1. Define `nodeTypes` object **outside** the component (prevents re-renders) [1]
2. Pass to `<ReactFlow nodeTypes={nodeTypes} />` [1]
3. Reference via `type` property in node definitions [1]

The `nodrag` class on interactive elements (inputs, selects) prevents dragging during
interaction [1]. Custom nodes should be memoized with `React.memo` [2].

## Props Taxonomy

The ReactFlow component accepts ~100+ props organized into categories [21]:

| Category | Key Props |
|----------|-----------|
| Common | `nodes`, `edges`, `nodeTypes`, `edgeTypes`, `colorMode` |
| Viewport | `fitView`, `minZoom`, `maxZoom`, `snapToGrid`, `onlyRenderVisibleElements` |
| Interaction | `nodesDraggable`, `nodesConnectable`, `panOnDrag`, `selectionOnDrag`, `zoomOnScroll` |
| Connection | `onConnect`, `isValidConnection`, `connectionMode`, `connectionRadius` |
| Keyboard | `deleteKeyCode`, `selectionKeyCode`, `disableKeyboardA11y` |
| Style | `noPanClassName` ("nopan"), `noDragClassName` ("nodrag"), `noWheelClassName` ("nowheel") |

## Event System

Full event handler coverage across node, edge, connection, pane, and selection events [21]:

- **Node**: `onNodeClick`, `onNodeDrag{Start,Stop}`, `onNodeContextMenu`, `onNodesChange`
- **Edge**: `onEdgeClick`, `onReconnect{Start,End}`, `onEdgesChange`
- **Connection**: `onConnect`, `onConnectStart/End`, `isValidConnection`
- **Pane**: `onMove`, `onPaneClick`, `onPaneContextMenu`
- **Selection**: `onSelectionChange`, `onSelectionDrag{Start,Stop}`

## Viewport Management

Two control schemes [26]:

| Mode | Pan | Zoom | Select |
|------|-----|------|--------|
| Default (map-like) | Pointer drag | Scroll wheel | Shift + drag |
| Design tool (Figma-like) | Scroll / space+drag | Pinch / cmd+scroll | Direct drag |

Configure via `panOnScroll`, `selectionOnDrag`, `panOnDrag` props [26].

## v12 Breaking Changes

| Before (v11) | After (v12) | Impact |
|--------------|-------------|--------|
| `import ReactFlow from 'reactflow'` | `import { ReactFlow } from '@xyflow/react'` | Package rename [6] |
| `node.width` / `node.height` | `node.measured.width` / `node.measured.height` | Breaks all layout integrations [6] |
| `parentNode` | `parentId` | Parent-child API [6] |
| `nodeInternals` | `nodeLookup` | Internal store access [6] |
| `onEdgeUpdate` | `onReconnect` | Edge update API [6] |
| Object mutation | Must spread new objects | Immutability enforced [6] |

## v12 New Features

- **SSR/SSG**: Define `width`/`height` and handle positions for server rendering [6]
- **Dark Mode**: `colorMode` prop ("light", "dark", "system") [6]
- **Computing Flows**: `useHandleConnections()`, `useNodesData()`, `updateNode()` [6]
- **useConnection()** hook, controlled viewport, `ViewportPortal`, `onBeforeDelete` [6]

## Built-in Components

- **MiniMap**: SVG overview with viewport indicator [21]
- **Controls**: Zoom in/out, fit-to-screen, interactivity toggle [21]
- **Background**: Visual grid pattern [21]

All can be rendered outside `<ReactFlow>` if wrapped with `<ReactFlowProvider>` [21].

## TypeScript Support

Generic type parameters for `NodeProps<T>` and `EdgeProps<T>`. Union types for multiple
custom node/edge types with different data structures [21].

## Testing

Cypress or Playwright recommended over Jest/Vitest. d3-drag doesn't work outside browser;
use `nodesDraggable={false}` and `panOnDrag={false}` for JSDOM environments [21].

## Gaps and Limitations

- No specific node count benchmarks in official documentation [2]
- No built-in WebGL renderer — SVG only [4]
- Smart edge routing requires third-party package [42]
- Testing with Jest/Vitest has significant limitations due to d3-drag [21]
